name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for waiver of the immunity of Maciej Wąsik
part_text:
The European Parliament has agreed to lift the legal protection that Maciej Wąsik, a Polish member, gets as an elected representative. Polish prosecutors want to charge him with breaking a court-ordered ban on holding public office. They say he attended Polish parliament sessions in December 2023 despite that ban. The vote means the Polish case against him can go ahead. Parliament found no sign that the case was brought to damage his political work.

- Polish prosecutors can now pursue their criminal case against Maciej Wąsik.
- It affects Maciej Wąsik, a Polish member of the European Parliament.
- Parliament's president sends the decision to Polish authorities and to him.
